text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (November 13, 2025) for 33 King Street

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (November 13, 2025) , for 33 King Street, Folder No. 25 251958 PRS 00 IV, and granted an extension of time until December 31, 2027, and to the satisfaction of the City of Toronto.
